No Specification 028 representation clause changes until the review is completed and the amendment is explicitly accepted.

The next stage must derive the representation model from first principles, design metadata and schema only after representation selection, map retained semantics into the new model, produce the Specification 028 delta, and only then build file-level migration disposition.
The stage must explicitly detect when an existing metadata field, heading convention, or document family is being retained merely through familiarity.

propositions.statement: The accepted assurance architecture uses selective first-class claims, explicit verifier warrants, executable sensitivity/specificity evidence where warranted, exact subject and revision binding, freshness/provenance requirements, and a base-revision assurance-policy ratchet.
The assurance architecture requires explicit trust semantics, executor capability modeling, and separation of execution surface from trust.

Provider and workflow mechanisms remain free, result adaptation is consumer-side, exact-result promotion is explicit, decision evidence is non-self-mutating, and oracle retirement requires qualification.
Deterministic and stochastic assurance remain separate; stochastic decision-grade campaigns are preregistered, use public-development/private-held-out separation, and prohibit retry-to-green.
Profiles compose without owning consequence semantics, decision-grade evidence is retained selectively, and assurance, orchestration, and delivery remain separate.

Current mechanisms may remain migration constraints, evidence, compatibility obligations, or temporary bridges but have no target preservation right merely because they are current.

AO/JW1 determines project process, governing transitions, and lifecycle routing; WARRANT-F determines whether an exact consequence is admissible under applicable assurance policy; Engineering/Delivery performs governed mutation only after required control and assurance decisions exist.
Assurance decisions may re-enter AO as project events and AO may activate assurance when a transition requires an assurance profile; neither subsystem silently absorbs the other.

propositions.statement: Authoritative relations use REPLACE, SUPPLEMENT, SPECIALIZE, and CORRECT; non-global relations must include explicit target and scope.
Relations must be authored once by the natural semantic owner where a natural direction exists, while reverse edges and closure are generated.

Git revision/history is the default recording history; universal bitemporal fields are not required, and effective/authority fields are selective only when applicability or authority materially differs from repository recording time.
Generated current-authority views must resolve explicit temporal semantics when present and must not substitute latest-commit recency for authority.

propositions.statement: Persistent receipts or manifests binding repository authority must use an explicit source path, source commit when immutable binding is required, sha256, GIT_BLOB_BYTES_AT_COMMIT hash basis, and content digest.

Working-tree bytes, normalized text, or external attachment bytes must not be silently substituted for canonical tracked repository authority; external attachment provenance records repository and materialization identity separately when both matter.

The implementation must provide a deterministic project-controlled authority resolver whose input covers action, target/scope, workstream/environment, actor/role when material, consequence class, and time when material.

A RESOLVED receipt must record governing semantic IDs, carrier paths, exact source revisions, applicability reason, relation/combination semantics, activated action-contract constraints, and freshness/availability, and probabilistic retrieval rank must not set resolved authority.
The implementation must support BROAD_CONTINUATION, NARROW_GOVERNED_TASK, and EXPLORATORY_RESEARCH reconstruction task classes.

A reconstruction contract must record task class, minimum safe orientation, must-load governing sources, optional evidence, negative context guidance where material, freshness, receipt requirements, and fail/escalate conditions; model-assisted intent classification must not remove project-controlled governing-source closure or safety constraints.
